name: ascendc-native-subagent-flows
description: K-Search AscendC Claude native subagent flows.

stages.name: code-reader
stages.instruction: Read the candidate project and write CODE_MAP.md. Do not edit source files.

stages.name: designer
stages.instruction: Read CODE_MAP.md and the attempt context, then write ASCENDC_DESIGN.md as the AscendC detailed design. Do not edit source files.

stages.name: codegen
stages.instruction: Read CODE_MAP.md, ASCENDC_DESIGN.md, and the real source files. Write IMPLEMENTATION_EXECUTION_PLAN.md before edits, implement the project, update CODE_MAP.md if project contracts changed, and write IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.md plus IMPLEMENTATION_DEVIATIONS.md if deviations exist.

stages.name: reviewer
stages.instruction: Review the edited project, CODE_MAP.md, ASCENDC_DESIGN.md, IMPLEMENTATION_EXECUTION_PLAN.md, IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.md, and IMPLEMENTATION_DEVIATIONS.md if present, then write REVIEW_NOTES.md.

eval_failure_repair.name: ascendc-eval-failure-repair
eval_failure_repair.description: Repair flow triggered by Python after benchmark/evaluation failure.

stages.name: bug-fixer
stages.instruction: Read the Python evaluation failure context from the base prompt, inspect the current project, and make the minimal source edits needed to fix the failure. Update CODE_MAP.md if project contracts changed.

stages.name: reviewer
stages.instruction: Review the repair, CODE_MAP.md, and the failure context, then write REVIEW_NOTES.md before Python re-evaluates.

continue_improve_assessment.name: ascendc-continue-improve-assessment
continue_improve_assessment.description: Assess whether a passed candidate has evidence-backed room for another focused latency improvement.

stages.name: improvement-assessor
stages.instruction: Read the referenced strategy, ASCENDC_DESIGN.md if present, current handoff files, CODE_MAP.md, and the real source files. Write IMPROVEMENT_ASSESSMENT.md with a decision on whether there is evidence-backed room for another focused latency improvement, including design/implementation deviation analysis. Do not edit source files.

continue_improve_codegen.name: ascendc-continue-improve-codegen
continue_improve_codegen.description: Implement and review a focused latency improvement after the assessment gate returns status=improve.

stages.name: codegen
stages.instruction: Read IMPROVEMENT_ASSESSMENT.md, CODE_MAP.md, the previous evaluation summary, ASCENDC_DESIGN.md if present, and the current source files. The assessment status is improve, so make one focused latency improvement within edit_scope. Update CODE_MAP.md if project contracts changed, and write IMPLEMENTATION_EXECUTION_PLAN.md plus IMPLEMENTATION_HANDOFF.md.

stages.name: reviewer
stages.instruction: Review the improvement attempt, CODE_MAP.md, and the previous evaluation context, then write REVIEW_NOTES.md before Python re-evaluates.
